text:
The fog had barely lifted off Veldmoor Bay on the morning of 14 September 2023 when the fleet gathered for the final race of the Pallister Cup, a contest that has long measured patience as much as speed. By the end, one hull stood apart. Seren Aduial, skippered by Niamh Corrigan, crossed the line first among 18 entries, completing the 212-nautical-mile course in 31 hours and 47 minutes.

Corrigan's role was never in doubt. The Pallister Cup Crew Declaration Form, filed with the Veldmoor Sailing Authority on 11 September, named her as captain, and Tobias Wrenfield, Chief Race Officer of the Pallister Cup Committee, confirmed her as skipper at the post-race briefing.

For a regatta built on slow-accumulating tradition, it was a quietly decisive finish.
